subject.title: [Bug]: v2026.6.9 regression — Codex app-server runs stamp internal turns "webchat"-bound, so heartbeat notification sends to Discord are silently denied (cross-context)

question: Which linked PR should be treated as the canonical landing path for the Codex internal-turn `webchat` binding regression?
rationale: Current main is still affected and three open PRs claim to close the issue; automation should not close the issue or create a new repair PR while maintainers choose between a narrow proof-positive fix, a broader diagnostics-bearing fix, and an incomplete narrower attempt.

options.title: Prefer the narrow scoped fix
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102232 as the primary landing path because it matches the `webchat`/`webchat` internal-turn shape, preserves real WebChat containment, and already has sufficient provider-layer proof.

options.title: Repair and land the broader diagnostics PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102217 only if maintainers want the new diagnostic event and script scope in the same release fix and the remaining proof/lint blockers are cleared.

options.title: Close the incomplete attempt after canonical merge
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102216 as partial overlap unless it is rewritten to cover the actual internal backend shape.

recommendation.title: Prefer the narrow scoped fix
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102232 as the primary landing path because it matches the `webchat`/`webchat` internal-turn shape, preserves real WebChat containment, and already has sufficient provider-layer proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice spans the outbound cross-context containment guard this person introduced and the message-delivery behavior that guard protects.
